Extract og:title, og:description, and og:image from Open Graph meta tags

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><title>Fallback Title</title><meta property=\"og:title\" content=\"OG Title\"><meta property=\"og:description\" content=\"OG description text.\"><meta property=\"og:image\" content=\"https://example.com/image.jpg\"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
